beats.event: Verona street brawl; Prince threatens death for further breach of peace
Romeo mopes over unrequited love for Rosaline
At the Capulet ball Romeo sees Juliet; both fall in love
Balcony scene in the Capulet orchard; vows exchanged
Friar Laurence secretly marries Romeo and Juliet
Mercutio killed by Tybalt while Romeo tries to keep peace
Enraged, Romeo kills Tybalt in the street
Prince banishes Romeo from Verona on pain of death
Romeo and Juliet share a secret wedding night, then he flees
Capulet orders Juliet to marry Count Paris in three days
Friar gives Juliet the potion that mimics death for 42 hours
Juliet takes the potion; is laid in the Capulet crypt
Friar's message fails; Balthasar tells Romeo Juliet is dead
Romeo kills Paris at the tomb, drinks poison beside Juliet
Juliet wakes, finds Romeo dead, stabs herself with his dagger
Montagues and Capulets reconciled over the bodies of their children
